# Limitations and disclosures
1. Same-lineage only: producers and the reviewer (review-E) belong to one session lineage and model family. No organizational independence, no competence review. Provenance in README.
2. Successor-conditional claim legs: FC-H1 and N-CLAIM-JOINT claim-leg expectations follow Registry 06/11 (PermissionError, no claim, no refusal write; human adoption pending). Under the frozen-literal reading of 03 L23 (durable refusal on claim) no durable refusal was observed (FC-H1-A07; N-CLAIM-JOINT-A04). Non-scored annotation per protocol 15.3.
3. Refusal vs issuance indistinguishable in one respect: a refused claim leaves a stage-`claim` ResolutionCheck row identical to an issued claim's row, so some assertions cannot distinguish them. Claim-leg "destination untouched" assertions cannot fail because claim issuance has no destination interface.
4. Joint, not isolated: FXE-JOINT and N-CLAIM-JOINT move more than one binding member (see diffs in README). Strict live isolation of effective_profile_digest is not possible by definition and construction (min(host, Registry); co-derived in one `_resolve`). authority_domain is informationally redundant with manifest_digest. Neither isolation is demonstrated. No pin-export case was run; the authority_domain isolation (record 12 item 1) is "not independently demonstrated for this member" unless the Architect decides otherwise.
5. FXE freshness-extension route changes only the extension limit; no age extension is granted (`age_extensions` [0,0]).
6. Host cases n=1 each, same lineage, shared D-1 fixtures; they do not discharge Q3 or record 12 item 2 (the reading of "two independent fixtures" is ambiguous) and the masked-host limit must be stated alongside. The unmasked-host controls are not isolating.
7. Row-form deviation (protocol section 16): host cases FC-H1..FC-H3b write plain D-1 rows without protocol/run/case_id/t_start/t_end keys, EXCEPTION rows with tracebacks, or before/after journal snapshots. Not waived and not repaired; v1 scoring rests on the frozen assertions; disclosed.
8. Probe defect: evidence-only probe N-CLAIM-JOINT-C1-O01 raised verbatim `TypeError: d1_lib.rec() got multiple values for keyword argument 'result'` in run1 and run2. Gating C1 rows are unaffected. The probe is not cited as evidence.
9. Mechanics wording: statements such as "the ECB comparison was the refuser" are inferences from complementary diffs; for H3a and FXE C1 the evidence shows only that the ECB comparison produced no reason.
10. Coverage: no mutants; Python 3.11.18 only; CP 739efe7 with Registry pin a40fe755 only; one synthetic F4 provision-route exercise occurred, and record 12 item 7 (Class B) is not discharged.
11. Repeatability is two processes on one host about 6 s apart, not replication.
12. Pre-freeze stray scratch files `_bounded739.py` and `_pyc_scratch/test_bq_eff.pyc` exist in the producer scratch directory and are excluded from this package; no instrument changed after freeze.
13. Post-run integrity: pristine content hash and Registry pin were re-checked by the lead at 2026-10-30T18:00:29Z (equal to before); the instruments' own evidence contains no post-run hash record.
14. Retained pytest basetemp stores (236 files per run, incl. `.lock`) are shipped because several corroborations rely on them; scratch absolute paths appear inside them.
15. Evidence PR merge and Issue #240 state are recorded in the PR/issue, not here.
